title: Haptic Feedback Glove
summary: Force and vibrotactile feedback on fingers for realistic VR touching
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Force and vibrotactile feedback on fingers for realistic VR touching.

Working prototypes demonstrated. Engineering challenges remain before commercial deployment. Our research database tracks 2 independent sources on this technology.
